_comment: Documentation of what the jwt / saml oracles + the oauth-oidc-sim decode from the REAL committed identity fixtures (the oracles). No spec check uses from:generated — the visual primitives read the parse tree / trace probe directly — so these keys (all underscore-prefixed) are documentation the replay test asserts against the oracles, never injected expectations.
_jwt_header_decoded: {"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"} (base64url, decodes with no key — a signed claim, not a secret)
_jwt_algnone_alg: none (RFC 8725 §2.1 unprotected-token attack — empty signature segment)
_oauth_canonical: authorization_request, authorization_response, token_request, token_response, resource_request, resource_response (RFC 6749 §4.1)
_oauth_break_alert: invalid_request — RFC 6749 §4.1.2.1/§5.2, resource call before the token exchange (no valet key issued)
